standings.fields: W, L, WIN%, GB, home/road/neutral splits, conference and division records, OT, last-10, streak.

team_trad.fields: GP, MIN, PTS (points per game), +/-, per-team shooting splits.

team_opp.fields: Opponent PTS per game (points allowed), opponent shooting splits.

team_adv.fields: OffRtg, DefRtg, NetRtg, PACE, PIE - all per-100-possession.

schedule.fields: Game IDs, ET tip times, arenas, national broadcast, Emirates NBA Cup group.

schedule_2.fields: The two 11/21 cards the first read truncated, and the seven 11/22 games.

games.fields: Official final scores, one page per date; the day-strip calendar gives the per-date game count used for the completeness check.

gamebook.fields: Per-game quarter rows, club totals, inactives and officials - the source of every quarter array in data/raw/results/results_2026-11-18.json.

injury_pdf.fields: Per-player status (Out/Doubtful/Questionable/Probable/Available) with the stated reason, plus the explicit NOT YET SUBMITTED club rows.

injury_policy.fields: Filing deadlines: 5 p.m. local the day before; game day 11 a.m.-1 p.m.; 1 p.m. local for the second of a back-to-back.

player_trad.fields: Per-player GP, MIN, PTS, REB, AST for the rows used on this site.

players.fields: Per-player GP, MIN, PTS, REB, AST for the rows used on this site.

odds.what: Market prices (spread, total, moneyline, prop lines)
odds.why: No licensed odds feed is connected and NBA.com renders odds client-side only. Required for: any value/edge claim, stake sizing, ROI, leaderboard scoring.

live_ingest.what: A capture that covers the whole season's results without a manual read
live_ingest.why: The nightly ingest (refresh.yml surface 2) now appends each day's official finals, and 222 finals are committed under data/raw/ - enough to rebuild every one of the 30 standings records exactly. What is still missing is the *history backfill* for dates the repository did not capture as they happened, so a backtest over the full season is not yet runnable from committed data alone; backtests run on the captured window.

player_box.why: nba.com/stats player pages render season aggregates only for this client. Required for: minutes distributions, prop bet probabilities, injury replacement modelling. The season-aggregate GP figures in PLAYERS were read on 2026-11-14 and were NOT re-read in this capture; they are labelled stale on the player page rather than refreshed by arithmetic (F-19D).

future_injuries.what: Injury designations for game days beyond the next filing deadline
future_injuries.why: The NBA publishes a report only once a team has filed. For the 11/21 and 11/22 games the 5 p.m. day-before deadline has not yet passed at this capture, so no official row exists to read - those dates are absent from the report, not empty in it.

injury_pdf_bytes.what: The raw bytes of the injury-report PDF this snapshot transcribes
injury_pdf_bytes.why: Text was read from the official URL, but ak-static.cms.nba.com is not reachable from this sandbox (measured SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL), so data/raw/pdf/<release>.pdf is written by the runner job (refresh.yml surface 1) rather than by this session. The verbatim page-fetch transcript is committed next to the JSON so the rows remain checkable.
